prefill_source: Edge0 v0.2.0, edge0-strata/bench/prompts/standard-v1. See pinned upstream fixture links in README.md.
chat_decode: Library explanation, 512-token cap as described in this recipe; distinct from Strata standard-v1's short hash-table task.
agent_decode: Synthetic CSV parser coding-agent exchange. Earlier read_file and run_tests results are serialized tool messages; submit_patch is the only advertised tool for the timed follow-up.

reasoning_budget_note: A 128-token request budget makes thinking mode reproducible while leaving room for visible output under the 512-token decode cap.
